name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden And White Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers combining Wooden material and White Acrylic for a unique dimensional ornament design.
    - Available in 2 construction styles:
                +) Style 1: 3mm Wooden base layer with 2-sided printing paired with a 3mm White Acrylic decorative layer with 1-sided printing.
                +) Style 2: 3mm White Acrylic layer with 2-sided printing paired with a 3mm Wooden layer with 1-sided printing.
    - The layered construction creates added depth and allows custom shapes, cutout details, names, and decorative artwork to stand out beautifully.
    - Wooden material adds a warm natural look, while White Acrylic provides a clean and polished decorative finish.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
                +) 3.54 x 3.54 in ~ 9 x 9 cm
                +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
                +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
                +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
                +) 7 x 7 in ~ 17.78 x 17.78 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Features high-quality UV printing for clear, vibrant, and detailed personalized artwork.
    - Produced using precision laser cutting to create smooth edges and clean custom silhouette shapes.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a custom hanging ornament for Christmas trees, room décor, memorial displays, holiday decoration, and seasonal keepsakes.
    - Suitable for personalization with names, family names, dates, memorial messages, pet themes, home themes, and festive artwork.
    - The 2-layer construction helps highlight the design by combining a solid decorative top layer with a supportive printed or shaped background layer.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-lasting decorative use.
    - Easy to hang with the included hanging accessories.
    - Suitable for a variety of themed designs such as pet memorial ornaments, first home ornaments, family keepsakes, and holiday decorations.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, couples, pet owners, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, pet memorials, first Christmas in a new home, family celebrations, remembrance gifts, and holiday occasions.
    - Great for creating custom ornaments with names, meaningful messages, dates, and themed decorative details.
    - Ideal as a memorable keepsake to celebrate special memories and meaningful moments.
    - A beautiful personalized ornament that combines the natural warmth of wood with the clean decorative appeal of White Acrylic.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
